corrections.issue: The peptide is O-GlcNAcylated: NAG sugar(s) are O-glycosidically bonded to peptide Ser (SER-OG--NAG-C1, ~1.4 A) but were filed in the paired receptor_NN.cif and recorded only as pose_env_adducts, so pose_NN.sdf/cif represented the unglycosylated peptide.
corrections.fix: Moved the peptide-bonded NAG(s) into pose_NN.cif and pose_NN.sdf with the Ser-OG--NAG-C1 glycosidic bond(s); removed them from receptor_NN.cif. Mirrors the 4PJZ/T55 correction (2026-09-15).
corrections.note: pose_env_adducts and the peptide seq/token fields still describe the pre-correction (unglycosylated) peptide and were not recomputed; the pose structure files are authoritative.
corrections.derived_fields: seq/peptide_tokens list the amino-acid sequence only (the covalent NAG/ZOY is a modification, not a residue token) and are unchanged; provenance.poses[].atoms documents the source-subchain atom count and is unchanged; pose_env_adducts still names the moiety by its original role. The shipped pose_NN.cif/sdf now additionally contain the covalent moiety and are authoritative.

corrections.issue: After the peptide-integral moiety (NAG/ZOY) was moved from the receptor into the pose files, the per-pose atom and residue counts in provenance.poses were not updated and still reflected the peptide-only pose (the same counts were also stale in bmi_modes/poses.csv).
corrections.fix: Updated provenance.poses[].atoms and .residues to the current pose-file contents (pose1: atoms 67->81, residues 9->10; pose2: atoms 56->70, residues 7->8; pose3: atoms 63->77, residues 8->9; pose4: atoms 63->77, residues 8->9). peptide_tokens/seq are peptide-only and unchanged.
